From: Anna Cole <anna@suncrest.com>

Subject: On-site demo week of Sep 13 — conflict

Diego,

Quick update from my side — our VP of Ops (Henry) just got pulled onto an unexpected field trip the week of Sep 13 for a regulatory audit. He was the primary decision maker for the lab walkthrough portion of next week's demo itinerary.

That means we either need to move the on-site demo entirely (lab walkthrough + equipment Q&A) to another date or run the product demo portion virtually while we reschedule the lab visit.

Couple constraints to flag:
- Henry is only available the week of Sep 6 or Sep 27 due to travel.
- For any on-site visit we require a Suncrest escort and a completed site access form (biosafety clearance) — I attached the PDF.
- If we go virtual, we still want a hardware deep-dive and would prefer a shorter hands-on session first, then a follow-up on-site when Henry is back.

Apologies for the late notice — the audit was scheduled this morning. Can you share your team's availability for (a) an earlier on-site the week of Sep 6, (b) a virtual deep-dive the week of Sep 13, or (c) a later on-site week of Sep 27?

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Cole
Director, Partnerships — Suncrest Biotech
[Attachment: SiteAccess_Form.pdf]

Anna — thanks for the heads up and totally understandable.

1) Move the full on-site to the week of Sep 6 — we can do Sep 8 or Sep 10 (full day).
2) Run a focused virtual deep-dive during the week of Sep 13 (60–75 minutes) and then schedule the lab walkthrough on Sep 27.
3) If Henry can make any morning slot on Sep 6, we can compress the lab walkthrough to a 90-minute block and keep the rest remote.

Marissa / Jordan — can you confirm whether Jordan will need extra kit for the hardware deep-dive on Sep 8/10 (we may need to bring the beta enclosure) and whether Sep 10 morning (09:00–11:00 PT) works for you both?

I also attached an updated Mutual Action Plan with a proposed fallback schedule (see v2). If Suncrest can confirm escort and clearance timeline we can lock a date.
